reason: The README clearly identifies this as a Feishu bot integration for continuous messaging with a DeepSeek Harness agent, including session mapping and streamed replies. Human review is warranted because the README states that the project is no longer maintained and recommends a successor plugin.

summaries.zh: 将一个或多个飞书机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，以便在飞书中与 Harness 智能体进行连续对话。
summaries.en: Connect one or more Feishu bots to DeepSeek Harness for continuous conversations with a Harness agent in Feishu.

capabilities: Connects Feishu bots to DeepSeek Harness through QR-code setup
Maintains Feishu long connections and relays messages to a Harness agent
Maps Feishu conversations to persistent Harness sessions
Streams agent responses through Feishu CardKit cards
Uses the Harness standard agent preset, including web search tools
Stores and manages per-bot integration credentials through the Harness credential provider
